sourceSectionsRead: Systematic palaeontology: Etymology, Holotype, Type horizon and locality, Diagnosis; Description and Table 1; Phylogenetic results; Discussion; Methods

limitations.zh: 本页为 2019 年正模描述及相关比较研究的导读，不是完整物种专论。骨骼不完整，翼展为比较估计，模式地点年龄尚不能精确限定；没有可直接归于本个体的摄食观测、生殖或种群数据。系统分类名称按论文日期保留，PBDB 和 COL 概念不合并。未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: This is a reading account of the 2019 holotype description and related comparisons, not a complete species monograph. The skeleton is incomplete, span is estimated and the type horizon lacks a refined age. No feeding observation, reproductive record or population dataset is attributed directly to this individual. Taxonomic names retain their publication-specific scope; PBDB and COL concepts are not merged. There has been no external expert review.
